thread:
kevin: Hey design team — we need a compact creative kit for the Performance launch and the webinar next Tue. Main asks: a benchmark one-pager (latency vs cost visuals), a hero image for the webinar page, 3 social variants, and a flexible slide template that matches our brand. Deadline: first drafts by EOD Wednesday. Links & details below.

maya: Got it. Can you drop the brief and asset sizes? Also do we need motion versions for social?

kevin: Brief here: https://tiny.redwood/launch-kit-brief — highlights: 1) Benchmark one-pager showing apples-to-apples latency/cost tradeoffs across Hosted, Dedicated, Private. 2) Diagram that explains routing tiers + fallback logic in one slide. 3) Webinar hero (1200x628) + thumbnail (320x180). 4) Social: IG carousel (1080x1080), X image (1200x675), LinkedIn hero (1200x627). Motion optional but nice-to-have for X; leave as secondary.

ana: Small note — legal asked that any performance claims be hedged. Use "observed" or "typical" not absolute. Also call out model/instance configs in a footnote.

kevin: Good call. We'll include a small footnote: "Benchmarks generated using model X v1.2 on A100/40GB equivalent; actual results vary."

maya: For the one-pager I'm thinking: left column chart (latency vs cost scatter), right column short bullets + callout with recommended config per workload. For the routing diagram — want it to be simple icons (hosted, dedicated, private, fallback). Any preferred icon set?

sam: We prefer the 'Redwood UI' icon pack in Figma. Use the green/teal accents for throughput callouts and amber for cost warnings. Keep CTA button style consistent with our launch page.

leo: FYI — growth needs an SVG of the routing diagram so we can scale it into the signup flow. Also can you add an export for dark mode (inverted colors) for the docs site?

maya: Thanks. Questions: 1) Do we have final copy for the bullets? 2) Any required logos or partner lockups? 3) Who owns review for brand compliance?

kevin: 1) Ana is drafting the copy, she should post by tomorrow morning. 2) Only Redwood logo and model medallion; no partner lockups for this launch. 3) Brand review: design@redwood and legal review via brand@redwood — copy Ana, I'll loop them in.

ana: Copy update: bullet drafts uploaded to the brief file (see link). Language is intentionally conservative per legal.

design-bot: New creative brief created (ID: CB-20260315-45). Auto-assigned tags: benchmark, webinar, hero, svg-export.

maya: Working off the brief now. Quick art direction: keep the benchmark chart high contrast, use dot clusters to imply distribution, not precise numbers. For accessibility pick colors that pass AA. Will post Figma link when initial frames are ready.

sam: Reminder: we need embedded lead routing mapping so when ppl download the one-pager or register for the webinar they get tagged correctly in SFDC/HubSpot. Mapping below — can you include the suggested hidden fields on the thank-you page?

kevin: please use this mapping: ```webinar_signup -> campaign:performance_launch, lead_source:webinar, priority:medium
benchmark_download -> campaign:performance_bench, lead_source:asset, priority:high
contact_sales -> campaign:performance_launch, lead_source:contact_form, priority:high```

maya: Solid. I can add a tiny section on the one-pager "How to get help" with the lead CTA.

leo: For the slide template: include a title slide, content + diagram slide, and a data slide. Please leave editable text styles and master components.

maya: ETA — initial Figma frames + an exported SVG of the routing diagram by Wed 5pm PST. If motion requested, I'll deliver a 10s MP4 X-ready variant by Friday.

kevin: Perfect. I'll book a quick review on Thu 10am PT. tagging @design-bot to create checklist. :thumbsup:

design-bot: Review meeting scheduled: Thu 2026-03-19 10:00 PT. Checklist created: figs, hero, socials, svg, slide-template, legal-copy.

ana: Thanks team — I'll prep the copy notes and legal redlines ahead of the review.

maya: Uploading first frames now: https://figma.com/file/xyz — feedback welcome, will iterate.

kevin: Awesome work — please ping in this thread when updated. :rocket:
